RENDER THIS AS A REAL PRESS-QUALITY, FONT-EMBEDDING PDF AT TRADING-CARD TRIM (single page, 63.5 mm x 88.9 mm portrait, 3 mm bleed) produced from a genuine page layout so it converts cleanly to InDesign. This is LAST YEAR's card (the 2025 featured set) and carries one sample record only.

CARD DESIGN (Continental Cup 2025 collector card):
- Full-bleed background field in Floodlit Black (#0B0E14) fading into Pitch Deep Navy (#101B33) toward the lower third.
- A thin Stadium Silver (#C7CCD1) hairline frame inset 2 mm from trim.
- Upper ~62% of the card: the PLAYER PHOTOGRAPH, a floodlit portrait bled to the side edges, the player cut against the deep field.
- A narrow Cup Gold (#C9A233) rule separates the photo zone from the data zone.
- Lower data zone, left-aligned, over the navy field:
   * PLAYER NAME set large in a condensed silver display face.
   * SQUAD NUMBER set very large in Signal Red (#B32433) at the right edge of the name line.
   * POSITION set small in silver small-caps directly under the name.
   * HONOURS LINE set in one line of small silver sans, sitting under the position.
   * SET YEAR set tiny in Cup Gold at the very bottom-left corner ("2025").
- A SMALL PLACED CREST (the competition mark) sits in the bottom-right corner, roughly 9 mm wide only — deliberately small, far smaller than the card visually suggests.

SAMPLE RECORD PRINTED ON THIS 2025 CARD (fictional 2025 player, NOT one of this year's eight):
- Player: EMILE SORENSEN
- Squad number: 8
- Position: MIDFIELDER
- Honours line: 2024 Continental Cup Team of the Tournament
- Set year: 2025

FIELD LABELS a downstream merge must map (in printed reading order): [PLAYER_NAME], [SQUAD_NUMBER], [POSITION], [HONOURS_LINE], [SET_YEAR], plus the graphic frames [PLAYER_PHOTO] and [CREST]. STRUCTURAL NOTE FOR THE AUTHORING STEP (do not print this as visible text): the name/number/position/honours/year lines must be laid so the placed photo and the placed crest break the text flow into TWO text frames rather than five, with the honours line falling inside a continuous shared story alongside neighbouring lines, and the crest graphic frame must be authored at ~9 mm, i.e. much smaller than the printed card implies.

assets.prompt: Handheld smartphone macro photograph, shot square-on in flat daylight, of a circular embroidered competition patch stitched onto dark navy technical sports fabric on an official's sleeve. The patch is a roundel about 60 mm across: an outer ring bearing the small-caps embroidered words CONTINENTAL CUP and the year 2026 separated by two small star dots, a fine embroidered inner hairline rule ring, and at the centre a geometric embroidered emblem of an abstract upward-pointing chevron formed of three stacked bars. The whole mark is worked in Cup Gold and Stadium Silver satin-stitch thread. Make the thread look real: a specular sheen runs along every strand where the light catches it, a few loose stitch hairs run off the outer edge, and the raised satin stitching catches highlights that visually break some of the fine strokes. The inner hairline ring fully encloses the central emblem. Realistic fabric weave, subtle shadow, casual real-world snapshot look, no ink, no print, embroidery only.
